source: TWDB Llano Uplift GAM v1.01, model layer 7 (the Hickory Aquifer), in blocks of 4 x 4 model cells
units: metres above sea level (from US survey feet)
corners: block (row, col)'s corners are the model grid positions (row * block_cells - 0.5, col * block_cells - 0.5) to ((row + 1) * block_cells - 0.5, (col + 1) * block_cells - 0.5), placed by the polynomial

polynomial.terms: u = (col - col_c) / col_s, v = (row - row_c) / row_s; for each total power n from 0 up, u^(n-j) v^j for j = 0..n
